subject: NUT
body: A longitudinal-wave probe on steel (velocity 5,920 m/s) shows a back-wall echo at 6.5 µs (round trip). What is the thickness?
explanation: Thickness = velocity × time ÷ 2 = 5.92 mm/µs × 6.5 µs ÷ 2 = 19.2 mm (the sound travels there and back).
